title: Vortex Download Manager v1.0.6
changelog: Giveaway License Protection: Online hardware machine-ID binding to prevent duplicate/shared serial piracy
Real-Time Consumer Registration: Automated email and license pair synchronization via secure Google Apps Script webhook
GOTD Exclusive Branding: Tailored in-app promotional presentation and license badges dedicated for Giveaway of the Day
Security & Input Hardening: RFC URL validation, Windows reserved namespace guards (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL), and boundary checks
High-Performance Native Messaging: Hardened browser native host IPC with memory caps and strict origin validation
Zero Adware Guarantee: 100% clean verified binary with zero toolbars, bundled components, or third-party telemetry
